name: netw5
description: The MACRAW driver on the host's real network (NOT in the gate: a real DHCP server and LAN traffic). The release /etc/rc is staged back, so the network modules load at boot and /etc/netstart's dhclient takes a lease through the kernel stack; the probe's wire cases wait for the gateway that lease puts in the chip. Only means anything at kernel.netprobe = 1.  ntpd starts at boot and asks for each interface's flags by the name SIOCGIFCONF gave it: 2.11BSD's ifunit takes the first digit as the unit, so an interface name must be letters.  dhclient sets the lease through SIOCSIFNETMASK, SIOCSIFADDR, SIOCSIFBRDADDR and SIOCADDRT; the probe's routes case checks one default route through its gateway and the broadcast host route through the address, and a second dhclient at the end renews the lease, deleting the first's default route before adding its own.

screen_contains: bsdnet: five full frames sent in ticks

requires.reason: the probe C is compiled into the network modules only at kernel.netprobe = 1
